title: The deep's reaches: the ten lands past every floor's edge
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: The walls hold crystals that hum when you pass and light your way from within. This is The Crystal Hollows, guarded by the Prism Warden.
Cold air pours down from somewhere above. Pools have frozen solid, columns of ice stand where water once fell, and snow drifts down out of the dark.
Reaches join the dungeon to wide lands below. Each has a warden and a name you must remember.
The rock splits open on rivers of slow fire. Black stone pillars, cracked and glowing, hold the roof up.
The Crystal Hollows hum with living light. The Prism Warden guards the heart where stone sings.
The room here holds no sun, but lanterns float on chains from the ceiling. A single door waits at the far end, guarded by the Door-Keeper.
The deep ends here, where the rock becomes water and silence. A black lake holds your reflection twice as you cross causeways to the last island.
The rock splits open to show a cave of glass. Crystal grows in sharp shapes along every wall and hums when you pass.
The path here leads through a tunnel where the rock holds its breath. The air tastes of deep time and cold water.

crystal.text: Crystal grows out of every wall here in spears and clusters. The light comes from inside the stone.

emberrift.text: The rock splits open on rivers of slow fire. Black stone pillars, cracked and glowing, hold the roof up.

frostgallery.text: Cold air pours down from somewhere above. Pools have frozen solid, columns of ice stand where water once fell.

glowcap.text: Mushrooms as tall as houses, their caps lit from inside. The air is thick and sweet and full of slow green motes.

oldworkings.text: Somebody mined here for generations, then left in a hurry. Props and carts, rails into the dark, seams still glittering in the walls.

ossuary.text: Every one of the deep's dead seems to have been carried here and laid down. Skulls in niches, bones in drifts, statues no one remembers.

rootcathedral.text: The roots of something enormous on the surface have broken through the roof and grown down in arches. Pale light leaks through where they came in.

stormchasm.text: Lightning lives down here. It crawls over tall black spires and leaves the air sharp and blue; the floor is scorched.

sunkencity.text: A whole street of some old city, swallowed into the rock: broken columns, toppled statues, flagstones worn by feet.

underlake.text: A black lake under the rock, so still it holds the cave's lights twice. Old stone causeways run from island to island.
